messages.author: ce683b307e5b88d5
messages.subject: MSstatsPTM locatePTM
parts:
Dear developer team, 

I am trying to use the locatePTM function right now to locate some phospho position in their respective protein (could be on ST or Y) so I can provide MSstatsPTM with the PROTEINNAME info (Uniprot ID+ Site localization).

I am having trouble with a simple task: Defining the modResidue.

When I try:
PTM_location <- MSstatsPTM::locatePTM(
  peptide =  DIANN_PTM_subsample$Modified.Sequence,
  uniprot = DIANN_PTM_subsample$Protein.Group,
  fasta = tidyFasta("databases/Zebrafish_DanioRerio_OneEntryPerGene.fasta"),
  modResidue = "STY",
  modSymbol = "\\*"
)

locatePTM cannot find any site at all

When I change the modResidue to = "S" or to "T" then it is able to map the respective residues correctly but it ignores the other possible options

How do I have to define the modResidue that STY works?

"STY" does not work
"S, T, Y" does not work
c("S", "T, "Y") does not work either

Kind Regards
Klemens

messages.author: 13904eb0f06097b0
messages.subject: Re: MSstatsPTM locatePTM
parts:
Hi Klemens,

That function is actually older and I didn't realize it was still included in the package. It only works with one amino acid, however we have a new internal function called `MSstatsPTMSiteLocator` which should work better. I've included the link to the function below.

https://github.com/Vitek-Lab/MSstatsPTM/blob/430932466cde844df1b1de98fe12a55bf4d49639/R/utils_converters.R#L378

Devon

A string vector of peptide sequences. The peptide sequence does not include its preceding and following AAs.

A data.table with FASTA information. Output of tidyFasta.


modResidue

A string. Modifiable amino acid residues.
